title: Symthaea Counterfactual Evidence Intervention Plan v1

randomization_commitment_sha256.description: Commitment to the randomization plan/seed material. Raw seeds should remain protected until the declared reveal point.

required_conditions.description: Must be in the canonical order shown here; the Rust validator enforces the order and paired coverage.

pairs.description: Each pair is one opaque task/world/replicate with one isolated trial per required condition.

plan_commitment_sha256.description: Domain-separated typed commitment over all fields except this field. It still requires an independent pre-run anchor.

task_ref_sha256.description: Opaque evaluator-side task/world identity. Do not place questions, targets, or oracle labels here.

trials.description: Must contain each required condition exactly once, and randomization_order must be a complete permutation from zero.

policy_input_sha256.description: Digest of the exact policy-visible input artifact for this condition.

evidence_manifest_sha256.description: Nonzero digest of the condition-specific evidence/environment manifest. Each pair must use a distinct digest per condition so a nominal intervention cannot silently reuse another condition's evidence provenance.

seed_commitment_sha256.description: Opaque seed commitment for the trial; never include raw seed or hidden targets in this plan.

description: Pre-run paired intervention plan for measuring whether evidence changes an agent's answer, attribution, confidence, and abstention. The structural verifier cannot prove execution, secrecy, truthful telemetry, causal identification, or scientific correctness.
